title: Admissions, without the marks behind them
description: The order is the fact published. A competitive examination lists who was admitted and in what order, and is very often forbidden from publishing the marks — so the ranking declares ties: resolved with an empty sortBy, and the positions the results carry order the whole set (spec §8.2.1, §8.3.5).

rankings.label: Admitted
rankings.description: Declaration order is deliberately not the published order: the positions decide, not the array.
